sections.heading: Using this website
sections.body: This website introduces Imran Autos and helps you contact the shop. We do not provide customer accounts, online payments or an enquiry database on this website.

sections.heading: Information you choose to share
sections.body: If you contact us by WhatsApp, phone, email or Instagram, you choose what vehicle details and contact information to share. We use that information to respond to your enquiry and discuss your requested parts. Avoid sending unnecessary identity documents or payment information in an initial enquiry.

sections.heading: Browser storage and hosting
sections.body: We use session storage only to remember whether the short introduction has played in your current tab. No advertising or analytics scripts are included in this release. The hosting provider may process technical request information, such as IP addresses and security logs, to serve and protect the website. Published catalogue information and images may be delivered by Sanity.

sections.heading: External services
sections.body: WhatsApp, Instagram and Google Maps open only when you follow their links. Those services apply their own privacy policies and may process information independently.

sections.heading: Questions and requests
sections.body: For privacy questions, or to ask about information you sent us, email reshamwala2001@yahoo.com or call +923353436688.

sections.heading: Website enquiries
sections.body: This release is a catalogue and enquiry website. Sending a WhatsApp message does not place or confirm an order. The shop will confirm the part, price, stock and agreed arrangements before any purchase.

sections.heading: Vehicle compatibility
sections.body: Vehicle names and catalogue information are a starting point. Confirm the exact make, model, year, engine and part number with the shop before buying. Visual illustrations are for presentation and do not establish product specifications or fitment.

sections.heading: Prices and availability
sections.body: Any displayed price is in Pakistani rupees unless stated otherwise. Confirm current price, stock and any applicable collection or delivery charges directly with the shop. Product listings may change.

sections.heading: Delivery, returns and warranty
sections.body: Ask the shop to explain and confirm the applicable delivery, return and warranty terms for the specific item before payment. No universal delivery timeframe, returns period or manufacturer warranty is promised by this website.
